# v1.5 — Thicker no-key baseline + SearXNG + zero-friction BYOK

Fifth minor release. Focus: reduce dependence on any single free engine and
make bring-your-own-key frictionless.

## Added

- **Baidu engine** (default pool, no key) — strong for Chinese queries;
  `/link` wrappers resolved to real canonical URLs (200-required with one
  retry, baidu's /link is flaky); bot-junk guard armed
- **Sogou Weixin engine** (opt-in: `--engine sogouweixin` or
  `EASY_WEB_SEARCH_ENGINES=sogouweixin`) — WeChat 公众号 article search,
  content no other engine covers; requires a process cookie jar (SNUID) and
  decodes sogou's `url += '…'` JS stubs to real mp.weixin.qq.com URLs
- **SearXNG engine** (self-hosted) — set `SEARXNG_BASE_URL` and it joins
  automatically; fails with an explicit fix-it hint when the instance has
  JSON format disabled; requirements + docker one-liner documented in
  README (bilingual)
- **Cookie jar in both runtimes** — persistent per-process cookies; required
  by Sogou, more browser-like for every engine
- **BYOK guidance**: `doctor` SKIP rows now print where to apply for each
  missing key; README (EN + 中文) gained a "30 seconds per key" signup table
  and the SearXNG self-host section

## Rejected (probed, did not ship)

- Startpage — captcha-blocks datacenter IPs (`/sp/captcha-block`)
- Mojeek — 403 on both proxied and direct paths
- Marginalia — API endpoint 404, HTML SERP yields too few parseable results

## Compatibility

- No flags removed; default pool is now `ddg, bing, baidu`
- Node >= 18 / Python >= 3.11 unchanged; still zero dependencies
